rendered: Yes, for the first grouping in panel E. The text reports a pan-genome of 45[1] isolates with a total of 19,469[2] genes, of which 3155[3] are core genes (the text's core share is ~16.2%[4]). In Fig. 2[5], the first grouping's core bar is 3155[6], its dispensable bar is 7847[7] and its unique bar is 8467[8]. These bars sum to the text's total of 19,469[9] genes, and the core bar matches the text's core count. The other groupings in panel E use different category sets whose bars sum to different totals, so they do not match the stated total; the agreement holds only for the first grouping.

source.caption: Fig. 2. Phenotypic characteristics and genomic diversity of S. marcescens. (A) Temperature-dependent prodigiosin pigmentation phenotype; (B) distribution of the prodigiosin biosynthetic gene cluster among different biogroups; (C–D) GC content and genomic compositional characteristics; (E) pangenome composition and genomic variability; and (F) predicted host range of plasmids identified in S. marcescens. The figure summarizes the multi-level diversity of S. marcescens in phenotype, genome composition, and genetic plasticity.
